arguments.argument: One row per order: revenue, coupon code, the campaign credited with the conversion (if any — most orders have none, and that's organic revenue, not a bug), billing country/city, and whether this was the customer's first order. Coupon codes can't be reliably tied to "generated by an Ordo campaign" vs. a merchant-created one, so this shows the code as used, not its origin. No device/browser breakdown — nothing in this install tracks that at order time.
